reason: Place ice-mantled dust in cold outer orbits to work toward storing ice beyond the snow line.
expectation: I expect the cold region to preserve water ice in the disk, though the exact result is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: The hot inner region could show what happens to ice there, but I chose to follow the cold-storage goal first.

effect: The outer ice store is complete, leaving the inner-disk rocky mixture to make.
reaction: The distinction between surviving inherited ice and refrozen vapor was useful.
reason: This is the only available combination and may develop the disk toward the remaining goal.
expectation: I expect the young Sun to affect the disk, perhaps establishing its temperature differences, though the exact result is uncertain.

effect: The Sun and accretion have established a hot inner disk, advancing the remaining rocky-mixture goal.
reaction: The connection between distance and which materials stay solid is clear.
reason: This is the only available combination and continues the inner-disk sequence.
expectation: I expect it to develop the hot inner region further, though the exact result is uncertain.

effect: The inner disk's heat has vaporized earlier grains, so cooling may re-form solids.
reaction: It is useful to see that inherited grains can be reprocessed rather than simply preserved.
reason: This is the only available combination; escaping radiation should cool the vapor toward the rocky mixture.
expectation: I expect the vapor to cool and perhaps condense into solids, though the exact result is uncertain.

effect: Cooling produced refractory grains, which can now be combined with rock-forming dust.
reaction: The contrast between high-temperature minerals and preserved ice is clear.
reason: This is the only available combination and directly builds the remaining rocky mixture.
expectation: I expect a mixed stock of inner-disk rocky material, though the exact result is uncertain.

effect: The grains have formed a loose aggregate, but the inner-disk mixture goal remains unfinished.
reaction: The reminder that grains can have different heating histories is useful.
reason: This is the only available combination and continues processing the rocky aggregate.
expectation: I expect brief heating to alter or partially melt the aggregate, though the exact result is uncertain.

effect: Brief heating melted some solids into droplets; cooling them is the next available step.
reaction: Leaving the disputed heating mechanism open is a useful qualification.
reason: This is the only available combination, and radiating energy should cool the droplets.
expectation: I expect the droplets to solidify into rocky grains, though the exact result is uncertain.

effect: The droplets cooled into chondrules, ready to combine with metal grains for the remaining rocky-mixture goal.
reaction: Their textures preserving evidence of rapid heating and cooling are interesting.
reason: This is the only available combination and should bring rocky and metallic grains together.
expectation: I expect an inner-disk mixture containing chondrules and metal grains, though the exact result is uncertain.

effect: The stone-and-metal mixture completes the remaining goal; it is raw material for rocky bodies, not yet a planet.
reaction: The distinction between ingredients and a formed planet is useful.

mostWorthwhile.text: Cooling the molten droplets into chondrules was most worthwhile: their textures preserve evidence of rapid heating and cooling.

leastWorthwhile.text: Developing the hot inner disk felt repetitive, with only one combination available at each of those decisions.

surprise.text: I was struck that some inherited ice can survive while vapor refreezes, rather than every grain melting and refreezing.

arbitrary.text: Applying hot inner orbits to a disk already described as having a hot inner region felt somewhat redundant, though the result explained grain evaporation.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the rocky mixture and stored ice become larger bodies; the contrast between their histories made that next stage appealing.
